notes.title: Update Notice - APR 30
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are going to release an update to fix many issues that you care about! It will improve the game’s stability and player experience. The server will be down for maintenance.

Maintenance Time
12:30 to 13:30 am, APR 30, 2025 UTC+8

[h3]Balance[/h3]
Added different effects triggered upon transformation for Alternate.
[b]The Burning Man[/b]: Applies 6 stacks of Burn to nearby players.
[b]Bloom Split[/b]: Slows nearby players for 2 seconds.
[b]Mistwalker[/b]: Creates a patch of mist beneath the feet of nearby players.

[b]Betrayer[/b]
[b]The Reaper[/b]
Now reveals its target to all players after a brief delay.
Upon the target's death, it drops 3 additional Hearts and advances the Reaper's Evolution.
No longer triggers permanent Mark of Death when health falls below 50.

[h3]Character[/h3]
[b]Psychologist[/b]
Mind Reading: Now always verifies the identities of two players. If fewer than two players are selected by nightfall, random surviving players will be chosen to fill the remaining slots.

"We believe that verifying two players provides a safe experience for the Psychologist. However, verifying only one player—especially if that player is an Alternate—creates a poor experience for that player, as it can lead to the game ending prematurely with little suspense.

[b]Priest[/b]
Cycle of Life: Now marks an operator every night, rather than only marking one when a player dies during the day. Additionally, the display of the Priest’s passive skill buff has been optimized—it now keeps track of which players have been marked in the past.

[h3]Identity Verification Simplification[/h3]
All identity verification effects now only return "Operator" or "Not an Operator" results. The previous verification logic (such as "Alternate", "Not an Alternate", or "Others") has been completely removed.

This change was made to: - Lower the cognitive barrier of identity information - Balance the information asymmetry between Alternate and Betrayer when facing Investigators

Affected Abilities/Items:
• Truth Department (Inquisitor's passive)
• Cycle of Life and Death (Priest's passive)
• Mind Reading (Psychologist's active)
• Lie Detector (Item)
• Empathy (Mutation)

[h3]Bug Fix[/h3]
Fixed an issue where the Lone Echo in monster swarm would incorrectly drop materials 
Fixed an issue that prevented the Director from properly marking other players

notes.title: Mistery Free Pass & “Rock and Roll" Edition are Available NOW! 30% Discount!
notes.content:
Dear Players

We are about to launch our biggest update since release on April 25th!
Not only will we improve game stability and the overall experience, but long-awaited new content will also be implemented!
 The server will be down for maintenance.

[h3]Maintenance Time[/h3]
10:00 to 11:00 am, APR 25, 2025 UTC+8

[h2]Mistery Free Pass is AVAILABLE NOW[/h2]
Mistery Free Pass is now available on the store page—download and play now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528931/2741f43edb472d80ef82e33e9691dd2acbe960c9.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] The Free Pass will be permanently available on Steam, allowing players to enjoy [b]Three matches per day[/b].
[*] While in-game store, battle passes and other external content are locked, the core gameplay is identical to the full version.
[*] You can match with all players as usual, and achievements/progress will carry over after you buy the full version.
[/list]

[h2]Rock and Roll Edition is AVAILABLE NOW[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528931/fdb4b234a8497e864550d5af8f49f23124c39130.png[/img]

[h3]New Characters[/h3]
The Mystery Control Institute has recruited two new Operators: the Rockstar and the Director.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528931/e525e9e58a91b7bbffcfb945c0ca1652163501a3.png[/img]

[b]Rockstar[/b] – Can summon a rock stage to immobilize other players while concealing their own identity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528931/2a7068dca29e18a8df4b4930c638c53775f23033.png[/img]

[b]Director[/b] – Can deploy puppets to ambush passing Operators and monsters, while marking their locations in real time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528931/6d660c7916994fa204b33eea2a4988f9b7f0eb9e.png[/img]

[h3]Other Character adjustment[/h3]
[b]Gunner[/b]
High-Explosive Ammo:
No longer inflicts Bleed.
Now briefly reveals and marks the target.

[b]Spy[/b]
Lone Wolf:
After exiting stealth, grants 3 bonus damage for 10 seconds.

[b]Ghost[/b]
Mind Projection:
Duration reduced from 60s → 50s.

[b]Robot[/b]
First Law:
When self-cast, shield value increased from 30 → 40.

[b]Director[/b]
Fatal Jingle:
New model & icon for the doll. Slightly increased its movement speed and reduced lifespan.
Self-destruct damage reduced from 50 → 40.

[b]Psychologist[/b]
Mind Reading:
Skill description updated to better match actual effects.
Now tracks which players have been read in the current match (visible in the buff bar).

[h3]New Weapons[/h3]
This update introduces more versatile melee and ranged weapons, while also enhancing the ranged explosive/fireplay and melee fist-fighting playstyles.

Two new Melee weapons have been added—both benefit from fist and melee mutations.

[b]Boxing Gloves[/b] 
6 Parts + 3 Mists, 2 Damage
"Keep Fighting" – Gains 1 Damage per hit taken or dealt (max +6).

[b]Power Claw [/b]
1 Ideal Component + 4 Mists + 1 Boxing Gloves, 4 Damage
"Keep Fighting" – Gains 2 Damage per hit taken or dealt (max +12).
"Finisher" – Long charge time. At full charge, grants a burst of movement speed. A fully charged strike knocks back the target and deals massive damage.

Two new Ranged weapons join the arsenal: a flamethrower (firearm) and a grenade launcher (reusable throwable).

[b]Flamethrower [/b]
6 Parts + 3 Mists + 1 Pistol
Sprays continuous fire, damaging and igniting enemies in a wide frontal area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528931/6be2dcf38f394a0ddb3a4c04ecbc20444631679b.png[/img]

[b]Grenade Launcher[/b] 
1 Ideal Component + 4 Mists + 1 Flamethrower
Fires an explosive shell, dealing 60 damage and igniting the blast zone.
No ammo cost, but has a 7-second cooldown between shots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528931/6598d3c6646e1097cdfb68a0bdf0f30eca49c8d8.png[/img]

[h3]Other Weapon Improvements[/h3]
Redesigned Stun Baton model to better match the visual style of the Gauss Blade.
Invisibility Hat now visibly appears on your head when used. Because... well, you're wearing it. Duh.
Stun Baton & Gauss Blade now emit sparking electricity when fully charged, giving both the wielder and opponents a clear visual cue.

[h3]New Entities[/h3]
[b]The Birth Chamber[/b]
The Chamber continuously spawns dolls. These dolls gradually reduce the sanity of nearby players, and their attacks apply a stacking damage-over-time effect.
When the Chamber dies, all surrounding dolls perish simultaneously.

[b]The Lonely Echo[/b]
The Lonely Echo emits sound waves that ricochet off terrain, dealing damage across a wide area.

[b]Shadow of the Mist[/b]
In half of the matches, the Shadow of the Mist will spawn inside the shelter in place of the Human Based Tree. Defeat it grants players multiple batteries and a Second Chance.
Mind Devour: The Shadow of the Mist drains sanity with each attack. The lower a player's sanity, the more damage they take from it.
Multi-Strike: The Shadow of the Mist rapidly attacks three times in a cone-shaped area in front of it.
Mist Breath: It exhales a dense fog, blinding players in a wide area while continuously draining their health, sanity, and stamina.
Split: When its health is low, the Shadow of the Mist divides into multiple fragments. These fragments can pounce on players and release damaging mist clouds.

[h3]New Alternate & Betrayers[/h3]

[b]Alternate: The Invisible Man[/b]
Transform into the Invisible Man. During the transformation, you remain permanently invisible. After exiting invisibility, you will briefly become invisible again.
Additionally, you gain the skill: Blink. Teleport to the target location.

[b]Alternate: Mistwalker[/b]
Transform into the Mistwalker. During the transformation, characters within a certain range around you are blinded and continuously lose sanity.
Additionally, you gain the skill: Mist Surge. Release a large cloud of mist that causes non Alternate within it to continuously lose sanity. If sanity is insufficient, they lose an equal amount of health instead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528931/227481458288b365892b255e50beb04b403b751c.png[/img]

[b]Other Alternate Adjustments[/b]
[b]The Burning Man[/b]
Lv 1:
No longer deals bonus damage to burning targets.
Attacks now inflict Burn and grant a 10% movement speed bonus.
Lv 2:
Movement speed bonus reduced from 35% → 25%.
Lv 3:
Gains 3 bonus damage.
Bonus damage to burning targets increased from 15% → 25%.

[b]Rupture[/b]
Lv 1:
Gains 3 bonus damage and 10% movement speed increase.
Lv2:
Movement speed bonus reduced from 35% → 25%.

[b]Grip of Lunacy[/b]
Lv 1:
Now only drains sanity to zero (no longer causes continuous sanity loss to nearby players).
Lv 2:
Upon transformation, gains 25 max HP. 
Lv 3:
Upon transformation, gains 50 max HP. 

[b]Skin Taker[/b]
Lv 1:
Duration reduced from 90s → 45s.
No longer regenerates HP while transformed.
Lv 2:
Duration reduced from 90s → 75s.
Bonus damage reduced from 5 → 3.
Gains 25 max HP.
Lv 3:
Bonus damage reduced from 8 → 6.
Gains 75 max HP.

[b]Betrayer: The Reaper[/b]
Pre-Evolution: "Mark of Death"
Mark Prey: Select a player as your target. Once their HP drops below 50, they become permanently marked.
Gain stat bonuses for each marked prey killed. After 3 marked prey die, you evolve.

Evolved Form: "Ruthless Pursuit"
Stealth & Ambush: Turn invisible, then teleport to the lowest-HP target on the field. Next attack deals 50 damage and stuns the victim.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528931/8312294727a11985fd84c08f1985ffaa0d946bb6.png[/img]

[h3]New Mutation[/h3]
Explosive Rounds: Gun attacks trigger a 4m-radius explosion (20 damage) on hit. Cooldown: 5s. Bloodhound: Reveals the location of the nearest target with <50 HP.
Tactical Evasion: After dodging, regain 5 Stamina/sec for 5s and take 20% less damage during this time.
Last Stand: Once every 150s, if your HP drops below 50, gain 2s of invincibility.

[h3]New Encounters[/h3]
Recycler Machine: Lets you dismantle items from your inventory.
Plague Doctor's Mask: Trigger a devastating plague. Vaccinate early for immunity. Can wear the mask to become a carrier of the plague.
Joker's Mask: Wearing it drives you temporarily insane, but grants bizarre buffs.
Gravity Gun: Grants a weapon that lets you place mini black hole traps in the environment.
Quiz: Receive $1 billion cash... but an invincible snail will hunt you forever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528931/b70f3f633d092ffb8559ecc264519a0b5a99b28b.png[/img]

[h3]Encounter Spawn Adjustments[/h3]
Zone Changes: Some encounters no longer spawn in the inner zone on Day 1—now appear in the outer zone instead.
Containment Cabinets: Most encounters are now placed inside labeled cabinets for better new-player clarity, with more standardized positioning.
Delayed High-Tier Encounters: Stronger encounters spawn starting Day 3 to avoid early-game imbalance.
Temporary Removal: The "Corpse" encounter in hospitals is disabled for now.

[h3]Map[/h3]
Bud Spawns: Buds can no longer spawn directly adjacent to each other.
Hidden Spot Removal: Reduced overly concealed locations to increase Imposter vulnerability when harvesting buds.
Safe Spacing: Safes no longer spawn right next to each other.
Emotion Cocktail Relocation: Removed from dual safes, now exclusively obtainable via the "Emotion Sponge" encounter.

[h3]Miscellaneous Improvements[/h3]
New in Lobby: Added an "Imposter Test Chamber" for players to preview transformation effects.
Sound Fix: Imposter transformation SFX now replace previous ones instead of stacking.
System Update: Unlocked characters can now be purchased directly with Neuro in the Collection . If you unlock a character through the Battle Pass that you already own, you will be refunded the equivalent amount of Neuro.
Optimization: Reduced polygon counts for some character models.

[h3]UI[/h3]
Updated the style of the new player guide lines.
Replaced the style of the throwing range indicator.
The "Loot All" button in corpses has been removed to prevent looting from becoming a frustrating speed-based competition.
Added a universal charge indicator for weapons with charge mechanics.

[h3]Tutorial[/h3]
Enhanced the tutorial's text and voice-over. Added BGM to certain scenes.
Improved the style of tutorial UI indicators—they should now be more noticeable.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
Fixed a bug that caused the attack rate of machine guns and chainsaws to behave unexpectedly.
Fixed a bug that prevented character corpses from using the player's skin model.

Transform into the Invisible Man. During the transformation, you remain permanently invisible. After exiting invisibility, you will briefly become invisible again.

Optimized the text of some keywords.

Added a new BP.

notes.content:
大家好！

我们是游戏边界工作室。非常感谢大家对此次《幽霾》限时测试（8月8日-8月13日）的支持！

由于《幽霾》还处于开发阶段，此次测试并未实装一些便捷功能，比如匹配、快速加入等。在游戏过程中有朋友可能会有疑惑，本文为大家带来测试期间常见问题的解答。

[b]本次测试共计测试几天？[/b]
8月8日至8月13日，服务器开启时间为每晚19：00至23：00。在此时间段外，无法进入游戏。

[b]我的Steam账号是阿根廷区的，可以玩吗？[/b]
本次测试只向中国大陆和港澳台用户开放，建议您使用国区账号游玩，否则可能会无法进入游戏。

[b]如何创建房间并开始游戏？[/b]
主界面>>调查事件>>发起调查>>加载页面>>确认选择角色。选好角色后，会进入游戏大厅，等待其他玩家加入并准备，房主就可以开始游戏。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528931/600854678371f529429cfd34a9c501a5d052198d.png[/img]
如果你是房主，将你的房间名字或者房间ID告诉你的小伙伴，让他们加入你的游戏！
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528931/f8c51b9234cae0bafd803366f6c7389e37c4dbc1.png[/img]

[b]如何加入其他人的房间？[/b]
主界面>>浏览事件>>点击你想加入的房间>>进入房间>>确认选择角色。选好角色后，会进入游戏大厅，等待其他玩家加入并准备，以及房主开始游戏。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528931/fe5d34b28dbf88849e85c0efb12ac49251caf78a.png[/img]

[b]我的麦克风检测不到语音收发怎么办？[/b]
请尝试：电脑桌面>>右击右下角扬声器图标>>声音设置>>找到麦克风输入>>选择麦克风阵列
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528931/b13dbc1eb8f6b7585e5651c13c4a236940200f0a.png[/img]

[b]我在游戏途中掉线了怎么办？[/b]
请尝试断线重连。断线五分钟内，可以重连回房间。如超过五分钟，请重新加入一局新游戏。

[b]我可以为《幽霾》此次游戏测试直播，或者制作视频吗？[/b]
请不要直播游戏和制作视频。因为本次测试内容为游戏研发中版本，不代表游戏最终品质。

我们期望这次测试，能让一直在期待的玩家们不仅能率先游玩到《幽霾》完整的多人游戏体验，并借此机会与大家交流，帮助我们发现并修正游戏中现存的一些问题。我们非常期待您的反馈和建议，您的反馈是《幽霾》不断完善的动力！
